diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~32% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.072), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.8598. Series context: trend strength 0.8481 and seasonal strength 0.0633; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.072); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.756.
